description: The Airflow DAG (and task) that produces a table, from DataHub: datahub_list_datasets returns the producing DataJob as 1-hop lineage, so no separate lineage call is needed.

cases.name: dag_fct_dau
cases.query: Which Airflow DAG produces core_data.fct_dau? Reply with a single JSON object only. Do not wrap it in markdown fences and do not add any other text. Required shape: {"table": "<db.table>", "dag": "<Airflow DAG id or null>"}
cases.notes: Gold verified against DataHub lineage on 2026-11-20 (GMS via kubectl port-forward).
